part.label: Gooseneck Cable Guide
part.description: A wall-mounted cable guide arm: a square channel swept along a bent 3D path (up, over, and partway back down) via `swept_profile` and brepjs's real `sweep()` operation -- a shape none of the other component kinds can approximate directly. The path's first segment runs straight up (parallel to Z), matching the profile's fixed orientation, then bends twice.

components.description: 6mm square channel, swept up 15mm, over 20mm, then back down 10mm.
